missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Annoyed repetition. 'Опять' means again and modifies 'опоздал', stressing that the lateness has happened once more. It is the colloquial twin of 'снова' and often carries a tone of irritation.
Strategic focus: Recurring weather. 'Опять' modifies 'собираются' to show the clouds are gathering again. The adverb sits before the verb, marking a familiar repeat of the scene.

missions.phrase: Он опять рассказывает ту же историю.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Tiresome repetition. 'Опять' modifies 'рассказывает' to mark the retelling as one more in a series. The adverb conveys mild weariness, very natural in casual speech.
Strategic focus: Repeated breakdown. 'Опять' modifies 'сломался' to stress that the lift has failed again. Placed before the verb, it underlines a recurring everyday annoyance.
Strategic focus: Repeating a mistake. 'Опять' modifies 'заблудились' to show getting lost happened once more. The adverb hugs the verb and gives the sentence a rueful, conversational feel.
Strategic focus: Repetition in a question. 'Опять' modifies 'плачешь' to ask why the crying has resumed. With 'почему' it gives the question a worried or impatient tone.
Strategic focus: Recurring nuisance. 'Опять' modifies 'слушает' to mark the loud music as a repeat offence. The adverb sits before the verb and carries clear everyday exasperation.

missions.phrase: Я опять забыл, как тебя зовут.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Repeated forgetting. 'Опять' modifies 'забыл' to admit the lapse has happened before. Placed before the verb, it adds a self-deprecating, apologetic note.

missions.phrase: Цены опять выросли в этом месяце.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Renewed change. 'Опять' modifies 'выросли' to show the prices rose once more. The adverb marks an unwelcome repetition, common in everyday complaints.
Strategic focus: Proposing a repeat. 'Опять' modifies 'сыграем' inside a 'давай' suggestion to play once more. Here the adverb carries a neutral, friendly wish to do it again.
